diagnosticDefinitions.stalledTicks: Alive, steering (|x|+|y| >= 0.5) without dash, shield, lunge or knockback on each of the last 15 ticks, yet never more than 15 units from where the window began. Counts wall pushing and tight jitter; a wide back-and-forth around an obstacle is missed.
diagnosticDefinitions.noSightTicks: Both alive and the centre-to-centre segment crosses a wall. Counted for every move, including lobs and aim-point placements that can act without a direct line.
diagnosticDefinitions.idleTicks: Alive with a live opponent, moved under 0.5 units this tick and neither attacking nor in an attack, channel or swipe. Includes steering into a wall and deliberate waiting.
diagnosticDefinitions.longestIdleTicks: Longest consecutive run of idle ticks.
diagnosticDefinitions.edgeTicks: Alive within 45 units of the playable arena boundary; diagnostic, not a penalty.
diagnosticDefinitions.cornerTicks: Alive within 45 units of two boundaries.
diagnosticDefinitions.damageDealt: Health damage from hit events this fighter owned against the opponent.
diagnosticDefinitions.damageTaken: Health damage from all hit events on this fighter, including self-damage.
